        elif final == 'common cold' and not cold_marks:
            final = 'allergy'
            guard_fired = True
        elif final == 'migraine' and not migraine_marks and htn_marks:
            final = 'hypertension'
            guard_fired = True

        # --- stage 4: adjudicate within the confusion group -------------------------------
        if not guard_fired:
            candidates = confusion_groups.get(final, [])
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                rule = group_rules.get(final, skin_rule if has_rash else "")
                final = ask_adjudicate(candidates, rule, final)
                # re-apply the strongest deterministic guards after adjudication
                if final == 'pneumonia' and not pneumonia_marks:
                    final = 'bronchial asthma'
                if final == 'peptic ulcer disease' and not pud_marks and typhoid_marks:
                    final = 'typhoid'
                if final in ('allergy', 'common cold') and has_rash:
                    final = 'chicken pox'
                if final == 'common cold' and not cold_marks:
                    final = 'allergy'

        if final not in self.labels:
            final = "allergy"

        return dspy.Prediction(disease=final)

            if best is not None:
                return best
            for key, label in synonyms.items():
                if key in text and label in pool:
                    return label
            return None

        symptoms = inputs.get("symptoms", "")
        cues = scan_cues(symptoms)

        first = self.classify(symptoms=symptoms, observed_cues=cues)
        primary = normalize(getattr(first, "disease", None), allowed)
        if primary is None:
            primary = 'common cold'

        candidates = confusions.get(primary, [primary])
        final = primary
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            second = self.differential(
                symptoms=symptoms,
                observed_cues=cues,
                candidate_diseases=", ".join(candidates),
            )
            picked = normalize(getattr(second, "disease", None), candidates)
            if picked is not None:
                final = picked

        if final not in allowed:
            final = primary

        return dspy.Prediction(disease=final)
